scientific_question: Do sparse Koopman autoencoders, including matched one-refinement LISTA-SB, improve direct long-horizon forecasting on ten chaotic Dysts systems sampled at the intended dt times 30?

invalid_predecessor.finding: Historical KAE native-cache trajectories used intrinsic Dysts dt while cache keys and paper text labeled dt times 30. H100/H2000/H4000/H5000 therefore covered about 0.02/0.40/0.80/1.00 characteristic periods, not 0.60/12/24/30.
invalid_predecessor.impact: All historical KAE Dysts rows and physical-horizon claims are quarantined. The canceled one-refinement replacement jobs 10173118, 10173119, and 10173120 produced no trained model.
invalid_predecessor.repair: Propagate the override to the native integrator, use schema-3 exact caches with split-disjoint initial conditions, and retrain every comparator on the corrected discrete-time problem.

time_grid.integrator: Dysts adaptive native integrator for train, checkpoint-validation, policy, and test futures
time_grid.preflight: All ten installed native timesteps must match the frozen values; returned increments must equal requested dt; nine corrected points must agree within 1e-5 normalized max error with every 30th point of a native-grid integration.

cache.profile: full: 200 trajectories, 30000 usable transitions after 2000-step warmup

model_contract.dense_baseline: tanh hidden activation, dense K, zero sparsity coefficient, no shrinkage/final ReLU/top-k/block penalty
model_contract.only_lista_sb_structural_treatments: sign-split output and soft-block regularization; refinement count is matched to the other LISTA rows

primary_metrics: per-system paired-seed log MSE ratio to Dense MLP tanh
evaluation.secondary: fixed periodic reencoding sensitivities are retained, but test-set best-periodic is exploratory and cannot support the main claim
evaluation.future_operational_endpoint: Select a cadence on the policy split, freeze it, and test once; this is separate from the direct architectural endpoint.
evaluation.nonfinite_rule: Track survival per initial condition; finite prefixes never outrank complete trajectories.

statistics.reporting: system-level paired effects, ten-system win count, robust aggregate and uncertainty; do not treat 150 fits as independent systems

compute.packing: 12 concurrent fits per L40S-class GPU, 32 GiB host memory
compute.smoke: 12 fits spanning all six recipes on corrected Chua smoke caches; all receipts/losses finite and pack GPU utilization audited before full cache generation
